description: Only half-season manager records with games managed strictly greater than 53 are included.

c.request: Looking only at `manager_half` stints where games managed (`g`) pass the 53-game mark, what is each team's average loss rate (losses `l` divided by games managed `g`, ignoring missing values)? Give the average of those team averages across all teams, ignoring missing values, as a single unrounded number. Only half-season manager records with games managed strictly greater than 53 are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg_loss_rate) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg_loss_rate FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) AS team_rates;

b.request: For each team, average `l / g` across `manager_half` records with `g > 53` and nonmissing `l` and `g`; then average those team averages across teams, excluding missing averages, and return the single unrounded value.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 AND l IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id) AS team_averages;
b.raw: For each team, average `l / g` across `manager_half` records with `g > 53` and nonmissing `l` and `g`; then average those team averages across teams, excluding missing averages, and return the single unrounded value.

a.request: Using only `manager_half` records where games managed (`g`) is greater than 53, compute each team's average of losses divided by games managed (`l` / `g`), ignoring missing values. Then give the average of those per-team averages across all teams, ignoring missing values, as a single unrounded value.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) AS per_team;

d.request: For each team, average `l / g` across `manager_half` records where `g > 53` and both `l` and `g` are present; then average those team averages across teams, excluding missing results, and return the single unrounded value.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 AND l IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id) AS team_averages WHERE team_avg IS NOT NULL;
